notes.title: 70% OFF No Heroes Here during Steam Tower Defense Fest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30621290/3c88f6d69117ea12c9b09555625bc83ee707481b.png

No Heroes Here is a frantic co-op game for 1 to 4 players, available in local and online modes. Craft and use several items effectively whilst coordinating your ragtag band of non-heroes to defend castles and survive... Oh, as well as saving the Kingdom in the meantime! 

The game is 70% OFF until the end of the Steam Tower Defense Fest, so enjoy this special discount and invite your friends to play together either locally or online!

Don't forget to check the Steam page of No Heroes Here 2
A 3D co-op roguelite with new characters, mechanics and weapons to defend your castle!
No Heroes Here 2 is coming soon, but you already can add the game to your Steam wishlist!

notes.title: New Game Mode and Patch 1.4.1
notes.content:
Hello, Non-Heroes!

NEW YEAR = NEW GAME MODE

We are so glad to announce ‘Hardcore Mode’, a new game mode unlocked after finishing the game in Normal Mode. It brings to the player even more challenging and numerous hordes, increasing the level's difficulty. It is ideal for those who have finished the game and want to continue to venture into the universe of No Heroes Here!

We also fixed a lot of minor bugs, including a bug that was causing the game to not respond when the controller was disconnected.

Have a nice year! And always remember: keep playing and helping the realm to succeed!

All the best,
Mad Mimic Team

notes.title: Patch 1.4.0
notes.content:
Hello, Non-Heroes!

We are so glad to announce our latest update patch.

Patch Note 1.4.0:

- After some feedback from the players we balanced the levels from Noobland and Trollmeria, specially for 1-2 players.

- Changed the names from Gypsy, Eskimo and Midget Ogre, they are now called Fortune Teller, Fishermen and Mini Ogre (We apologize to anyone that got offended by those names).

Thanks for this amazing year!

Happy Holidays,
Mad Mimic Team

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
Hello Non-Heroes!

Here comes another patch with more bug fixes and some improvements to the Online flow. We've reworked the process of joining and creating new online matches, now it should be more straitforward. We've joined both functions, creating new rooms and joining new rooms in the same screen, the Online Lobby. Please report any bugs you find!

Changelist:

- Improved Online Screen flow
- Improved Menu navigation using analog stick
- Fixed issues with Krampus animation
- Fixed issues with Trojan Turkey animation
- Fixed issue with OSX progression and save data bug

Cheers,
Mad Mimic Team

notes.title: MAC OS Update! + Hotfix 0.2a
notes.content:
Hello Non-Heroes!

We are happy to announce that the MAC Version is live now! 
PC owners of No Heroes Here can also play in the MAC OS.

Hotfix 0.2a

Also we have a brand new patch, with several fixes and some small features that will help players find matches.


New Online Features!
After some considerations, we implemented a new way of playing the online version of the game. Before you would need to have the Level unlocked, before you could play it online. This lead to multiple complaints about players needing to "fast forward" games that just bought the game, so that they could progress together.

In this new version players now can join any non-private room and any level created by a host, the restriction for the online is now lifted. This will lead to players been able to better enjoy the game, where you can follow your friends that unlocked later levels. The restriction only apply when creating a new game, where you can only host leves that you previously unlocked. The restrictions still apply for the Achievements and Character Unlocks, where you need to unlock ALL the paths or branches in order to achieve them.

Level Select Navigation
Now players can freely navigate through the realms, instead of going through each level to reach the next or previous one. Players can use the Left and Right Ctrl in the Keyboard, the RT and LT in the Xbox controller and using R2 and L2 in the Playstation Controller

Balancing
- We've rebalanced the Level 8 and Challenge B in Noobland.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where you could not input a name with only two letters in the Character Select.
- Fixed a bug where the disable for the controllers were appearing for the keyboard aswell.
- Fixed a bug where you could not unlock the Savage, Chef or Midget Ogre. Now the player should correctly unlock them. They should appear correctly when finishing a level, so don't worry about it being a bug.
- Fixed the particle for the Health Bar appearing behind the bar.
- Fixed the light particle being behind the Medallion.
- Added Build versions for the game.
- Some small typos fix and localization.
- Added the correct Wwise credits.

Thank you, and happy crafting!
- Mad Mimic team

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1b
notes.content:
Hello Non-Heroes!

We have a second wave of hotfixes for the Online section.

Major Fixes
- There was a bug where after defeating Krampus, the players wouldn't be able to lose the game. That is fixed now.

Minor Fixes
- Various online bugs fixed
- Updated the Prefeitura de São Paulo logo
- Now the Room list will show all the rooms that are created, this should make people aware that there are other players playing the game
- Changed description for some Achievements.
- Now you should be able to track the ammount of items you craft, and enemies you kill
- The Localization prefs should be saved now, and reloaded after you start the game.

We are working on more fixes, so stay tuned!
Thanks for saving Noobland,

Mad Mimic Team

Fixes:

notes.title: Online Issues
notes.content:
Hello Non-Heroes!!

Hope you all are enjoying the game so far, and having fun with your friends.

We are currently experience some bugs in the online section of the game, and we are working ASAP to fix them so that you can enjoy a seamless experience.

ISSUE
A bug we are currently tracking is related to Pausing the game before the first wave in each level. This results in no enemies spawning on that wave, which makes the level impossible to finish.
We advise to NOT pause the game before the first wave, or during the Ghost balloon talk.

We are sorry for any inconvenience, and we will soon post a fix for these issues.

Thank you for saving Noobland! ːsteamhappyː
- Mad Mimic team
